Isolate learned relative weighting while retaining exactly the uniform baseline recency.98 and zero-centered ridge1e-6.

No body ID, phase, object/contact or future query enters model features.
training: Same E146 three fixed seeds,1500updates,AdamW3e-4,wd1e-4,batch128,clip1,normalized measured-next-motionMSE+.001 normalizedlogweight-square. Reuse the training implementation through explicit adapters; no best seed/checkpoint selection. Average all three Jacobians.
screen: At least5% lower ensemble position MSE than uniform32, neither joint count worse, scaled-rotation MSE<=1.05x. Passing allows full fitting control with the already fixed E151 posture rule and identical uniform/E120 references. It does not open fresh tests automatically. E120 unchanged.
